role: Client of attorney C. K. Sabrowsky, commenter
stance_basis: paraphrase states client favors construction only if entire undeveloped parcels are purchased
summary: Community Developers, Inc., represented by attorney C. K. Sabrowsky, expressed a conditional position on the Airport Spur: they support construction only if it results in the purchase of their entire undeveloped parcels, not just partial acquisition. The agency responded that right-of-way negotiations had been suspended pending completion of the Final EIS, and noted that the City of Milwaukee School Board's interest in the undeveloped parcels along Parnell Avenue would be investigated.
complaint_summary: Attorney C. K. Sabrowsky stated that his client Community Developers, Inc. supports construction of the Airport Spur only if it results in the purchase of their entire undeveloped parcels, making their position contingent on full parcel acquisition.
summary_quote: Stated his client's position with respect to construction of the Airport Spur is determined by economics and is in favor of construction only if it will result in the purchase of the entire undeveloped parcels.
